title: Terms of use
description: The terms for using GizaTourism.com: travel information, third-party bookings, affiliate links and copyright.
body_html:
By using GizaTourism.com (“the site”) you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the site.

Travel information is a guide, not a guarantee

We research every page carefully, but opening hours, ticket prices, entry rules, transport schedules and visa requirements for the Pyramids of Giza, Saqqara, Dahshur and Cairo change, sometimes without notice. Always confirm the details that matter to your trip with the official source, operator or hotel before you travel. You use the information on the site at your own risk.

Bookings are with third parties

We do not sell tours, tickets or rooms ourselves. When you book through a link on the site, your contract is with that provider (for example GetYourGuide, Viator and Booking.com), and their terms, prices and cancellation policies apply. We are not responsible for services provided by third parties.

Affiliate relationships and advertising

Some links on the site are affiliate links, which means we may earn a commission if you book through them, at no extra cost to you. The site also shows ads served by Google. Neither affects which places, tours or hotels we recommend. See our affiliate disclosure and privacy policy.

Content and copyright

The text, maps and original images on the site are protected by copyright. You may link to any page and quote short passages with a link back. Please don't republish whole pages or images without permission. Photos credited to other photographers or to Wikimedia Commons remain under their own licences.

External links

We link to official sites and other resources for convenience. We don't control those sites and aren't responsible for their content.

No warranty and limitation of liability

The site is provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of the site or reliance on its content.

Changes and contact

We may update these terms from time to time; the date at the top shows the latest version. Questions: hello@gizatourism.com.
